english.note: Use this more formal collective/count noun when referring to cattle as animals in news, official, or agricultural contexts rather than everyday speech.

examples.english: The farm transported a batch of cattle to the slaughterhouse today.
examples.traditional: 農場今日運送咗一批牛隻去屠房。
